daily_records AS (

        city_name,
        summary_date,
        avg_temperature_celsius,

        min_temperature_celsius,
        max_temperature_celsius
    FROM daily_weather_summary
    WHERE summary_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

    h.obs_date,
    h.hourly_count,
